# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 50 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Seth Writes the Tablets

---

**50:1** Seth wrote on tablets of stone and tablets of clay all the words of his father and mother and all their deeds.

**50:2** He wrote of the creation of the world and the fall in paradise, and of Adam and Eve's penance, and of the hope of the resurrection.

**50:3** He kept these tablets in a safe place, saying: 'These will be found in the last days.'

---
